description:
The current hamming_7_4.rs example is 358 lines, which is too long. Split into hamming_basic.rs (30-50 lines, beginner) and hamming_advanced.rs (150-200 lines, advanced tutorial). Update all cross-references and README.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Split hamming_7_4.rs example into basic and advanced versions” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.


## Resolution

Subsumed by overhaul issue `13dfe1a5`, whose REQ-01 governs example comments. `hamming_basic.rs` exists, and elementary Hamming material is outside the researcher audience.
title: Split hamming_7_4.rs example into basic and advanced versions
